jobs.title: Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description & Summary**

We’re a team that transforms vision into tech-enabled reality. We look for those who see technology not just as tools or platforms, but as the invisible infrastructure behind strategy, performance, and growth. We turn bold ideas into scalable, secure, and human-centered solutions.

  

**SHAPING TOMORROW**

  

Make a real impact, today, and tomorrow, through work that matters. Here, you will tackle today’s toughest challenges with a future-focused mindset; so our clients turn to us first when it matters most.

  

**Make a real impact**

  

In this dynamic environment, we are looking for an ambitious and self-driven **Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer** to join our **AI Software Engineering team** .

  
  

* Assist in the creation of the system design and functional specifications

* Drafting technical specifications for the several stages of the implementation project

* Design, implementation, testing and documentation of enterprise level tailor made multi-tier applications

* Implement integration with third party applications / data sources

* Utilise various workflow, document management, content management, portal systems / frameworks

Active contribution in business development activities, participating in meetings/presentations with clients, participating in the RFP process, preparing the necessary documentation  

  

**What you bring matters**

* At least four (4) years of relevant professional experience in Software Development using .NET technologies

* Bachelor or Master degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Sciences or related discipline

* Excellent programming skills in Object-oriented development and experience in .NET an/or .NET Core and related frameworks

* Sound knowledge of Asp.Net, Asp.Net Core and Core WebAPI

* In-depth knowledge of Databases and SQL (mainly MS SQL Server and/or Oracle DB, MySQL)

* Sound knowledge of client-server architecture and web services (SOAP/REST)

* The ability to use Design patterns and produce clean, maintainable and self-documented code is a must

* Hands-on experience with AI Spec Driven Development (SDD) frameworks such as BMAD-METHOD, Superpowers or GitHub Spec Kit (or similar, e.g. OpenSpec), and the ability to turn specs, plans and tasks into working code with AI coding agents.

* Be familiar with GitHub, Azure DevOps or similar platform (i.e. Atlassian JIRA, GitLab)

* Proven experience in Scrum Methodology

* Ability to use modeling languages (e.g. UML) for data modeling, design of business workflows and other types of diagrams

* Strong understanding of Multithreaded applications and High Performance web applications

* Sound knowledge of automated unit/integration testing processes and related frameworks (e.g. nUnit, xUnit, Specflow, Selenium or other)

* Any technical knowledge of Cloud environments and architecture (Azure or AWS) is considered a plus.

Any experience with React, Angular 2+, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, CSS is considered a plus  

  

**BRING YOUR BEST, EVERYDAY**

  

Your skills, integrity, and curiosity make the difference. At PwC Greece, we match that with an environment that brings out your best every day – supported by people who inspire, challenge, and grow with you.

  

What we offer goes beyond a competitive package. It’s about creating the conditions for you to learn, belong, and deliver impact. That means:

  

* Your work life-balance supported by a hybrid working model

* Your creativity sparked in collaborative office spaces

* Your career growing through local and global opportunities

* Your development advanced with continuous learning and professional certifications

* Your well-being cared for with extra leave days and wellness initiatives

Your perspective valued in an inclusive team where your impact matters  



Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? At PwC Greece, you lead by example. Our standards for quality and care are high – and together we surpass them. We redefine possibilities for our clients and communities.

  

**Challenge accepted?**

  

Our circle of connection matters - it’s at the heart of what we do. Click here (PwC life)

All applicants will be acknowledged and treated in the strictest c onfidence.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Infiterra**
===================

**Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.**

**Infiterra** enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

**Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.**

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

### **The role in a nutshell**

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

**Your goal?**
--------------

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

### **Our Ideal Candidate Profile**

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**
---------------------------

* Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
* Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
* A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
* Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
* Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.
* Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* **Feature Ownership:** Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
* **Technical Debt:** Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
* **Automated Testing:** Write robust automated tests.
* **Code Reviews:** Review your peers' pull requests.
* **Observability:** Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
* **Dependencies:** Surface cross-team dependencies early.
* **Clear Communication:** Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
* **AI-assisted Engineering:** Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

**What you'll bring:**
----------------------

* Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
* Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
* Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).
* Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.
* Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).
* Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).
* Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.
* Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.
* University degree in Computer Science or any related field.
* Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).
* Flexible working hours.
* Health and life insurance program.
* Learning & development budget.
* Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

**If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply!** **We’d love to hear from you!**

All applications will be treated with confidentiality. Please note that due to the high volume of CVs received, only candidates who are a good fit will be contacted for an interview.

As part of our commitment to diversity in the workforce, Infiterra is dedicated to Equal Employment Opportunity, ensuring that all individuals are treated with respect and consideration without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a freelance **Senior .NET Developer** to join a large-scale digital transformation project within the **Belgian energy sector**.

You will join an established Agile team working on secure **authentication, authorization and digital identity solutions** used across both modern and legacy applications. This is a hands-on development position combining **.NET/C#, Java, cloud, security and DevOps**.

The position is **full-time and hybrid**, with approximately **2 days per week onsite in the Brussels region**.

Your Responsibilities

* Develop, test and document software components and services using **C#/.NET and Java**.
* Build and integrate authentication and authorization solutions.
* Develop and document REST-based integrations and sample applications.
* Configure and extend components such as API gateways, reverse proxies, directory services and authorization engines.
* Work with **OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SSO and MFA**.
* Contribute to front-end development using **Vue.js and Blazor**.
* Work with **LDAP and SQL Server**.
* Deploy and maintain applications in **Kubernetes / AKS** environments.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines, automation and configuration management.
* Troubleshoot technical and integration issues.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
* Document technical solutions, processes and architectures.
* Collaborate with developers, infrastructure teams and other technical stakeholders.

Must-Have Skills

* Strong professional experience with **C# and .NET**
* Professional **Java development experience**
* REST APIs, JSON and YAML
* JavaScript
* Vue.js and/or Blazor
* SQL Server and LDAP
* OAuth2 and OIDC
* Authentication & authorization concepts
* SSO, MFA, HTTPS, CORS and web security
* Kubernetes and/or AKS
* Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Understanding of cryptographic concepts
* Good **English**, combined with **Dutch and/or French**

Nice to Have

* TypeScript, PowerShell or Bash
* React
* SAML2
* PKI, keystores and hash functions
* Experience with **Keycloak, ADFS, Okta, Ping Identity or Entra ID**
* Microservices architecture

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brussels

jobs.title: .NET
jobs.description:
05-10-2026

Brussels

**Senior .NET Developer met Java-ervaring**
-------------------------------------------

Voor een organisatie in de energiesector zoeken we een **Senior .NET Developer met ervaring in Java**. Je versterkt een bestaand team dat werkt aan oplossingen voor digitale identiteit, authenticatie en autorisatie. Je combineert softwareontwikkeling met de integratie van veilige toegangsoplossingen in bestaande en nieuwe applicaties.

**Praktische informatie**

* **Startdatum:** 02/11/2026, met gewenste opstart tussen midden oktober en uiterlijk midden november.
* **Einddatum:** 31/12/2027.
* **Locatie:** Brussel.
* **Werkregime:** voltijds, met doorgaans twee dagen per week op kantoor.

### **Jouw verantwoordelijkheden**

* Ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren van softwarecomponenten, libraries en services voor authenticatie en autorisatie.
* Uitwerken van voorbeeldapplicaties en codefragmenten die de integratie van deze services in bestaande en nieuwe applicaties verduidelijken.
* Configureren en uitbreiden van standaardoplossingen, zoals access managers, autorisatie-engines, API gateways, reverse proxies en directory services.
* Verbeteren en automatiseren van continuous integration en deployment, met aandacht voor configuratiebeheer.
* Samenwerken met IT-teams om technische behoeften, integratieproblemen en gebruikersvragen te begrijpen en op te lossen.
* Installeren en configureren van commerciële en opensourceproducten aan de hand van technische documentatie.
* Actief deelnemen aan de voorbereiding, planning, uitvoering en evaluatie van sprints.
* Verantwoordelijkheid opnemen voor toegewezen backlogitems en taken.
* Voorbereiden van workshops en overlegmomenten en opvolgen van acties en resultaten.
* Voorstellen, toelichten en valideren van oplossingen die aansluiten bij de vereisten, met duidelijke communicatie over eventuele beperkingen.
* Nieuwe concepten, standaarden en ontwikkelomgevingen aanleren en toepassen.

### **Jouw technische expertise**

Je beschikt over een sterke kennis van:

* **Softwareontwikkeling:** C#, .NET, Java, REST, JSON en YAML.
* **Scripting:** JavaScript.
* **Frontendontwikkeling:** Vue.js en Blazor.
* **Databronnen en opslag:** LDAP en SQL Server.
* **Authenticatie- en autorisatiestandaarden:** OAuth 2.0 en OpenID Connect.
* **Webbeveiliging:** HTTPS, cookies, CORS, Single Sign-On en MFA.
* **Cryptografie:** gebruik van symmetrische en asymmetrische sleutels.
* **Cloudtechnologie:** Kubernetes en Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* **Versiebeheer en oplevering:** Git en DevOps-principes.

Aanvullende kennis of ervaring is een plus:

* TypeScript, PowerShell en Bash.
* React.
* SAML 2.0.
* PKI, hashfuncties en keystores.
* Identityproviderplatformen zoals ADFS, Keycloak, Ping, Okta of Microsoft Entra ID.
* Microservicesarchitectuur.

### **Jouw profiel**

Je bent pragmatisch, neemt initiatief en werkt zelfstandig. Je combineert een positieve, constructieve houding met flexibiliteit en doorzettingsvermogen. Je leert graag bij en past je vlot aan nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen aan.

Daarnaast beschik je over sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt problemen doorgronden, passende oplossingen voorstellen en processen en architecturen helder documenteren. Je licht technische voorstellen overtuigend toe aan een technisch publiek.

### **Talen**

Je beschikt over een goede kennis van **Nederlands en/of Frans**, aangevuld met een goede kennis van **Engels**.

### **Voor kandidaten van buiten de EU**

Je beschikt over een geldige werkvergunning waarmee je in België mag werken en een geldige verblijfsvergunning die je verblijfsrecht in België bevestigt.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**908 Devices Inc. (NASDAQ: MASS)** is revolutionizing chemical analysis with its simple handheld devices, addressing life-altering applications. The Company's devices are used at the point-of-need to interrogate unknown and invisible materials and provide quick, actionable answers in vital health, safety and defense tech applications, addressing the fentanyl and illicit drug crisis, toxic carcinogen exposure, and global security threats. The Company designs and manufactures innovative products that bring together the power of complementary analytical technologies, software automation, and machine learning. For more information, visit 908devices.com

908 Devices has a corporate office in Burlington, MA with a manufacturing center in Danbury, Connecticut and a growing population of remote staff worldwide.

908 Devices is revolutionizing chemical and material analysis through innovative handheld and point-of-need technologies that deliver rapid, actionable insights. As part of 908 Devices, our NIRLAB team in Lausanne, Switzerland develops advanced handheld spectroscopy solutions that combine near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy with machine learning to enable second-by-second, on-the-spot material analysis.  
Originally established in 2018, NIRLAB's technology is used by customers across 30 countries worldwide and is now part of 908 Devices' broader portfolio of analytical technologies and solutions.

**Location** : 80-100%, Lausanne, minimum 1day/week on-site

**SOFTWARE ENGINEER**  
We are seeking a proactive, experienced, and innovative Software Engineer to strengthen our software development team. This role focuses on designing, developing, and optimizing software components that power our advanced spectroscopy solution. The main software components are a mobile application, a web platform, and a dedicated ML model runtime. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in at least one of the following domains:

* Mobile app development on Android and iOS, ideally with Xamarin/.NET MAUI
* Frontend development, ideally with Svelte and SvelteKit
* Backend development, ideally with Django and Django rest framework
* Deployment of ML models for use with production systems
* Integration of Bluetooth Low Energy devices

**Tasks:**

* Collaborate with the software development team and other departments to design, develop, and maintain product features that meet (internal and external) user's needs.
* Collaborate with the software development team to rigorously test software components to ensure adherence to high quality standards.
* Collaborate with the software development team to ensure the security, availability and high performance of software components.
* Collaborate with the software development team to reproduce and fix reported and discovered issues.
* Proactively contribute to software products improvement, on the user interface, technical, and development process levels.
* Maintain pragmatic development and operations focused technical documentation.
* Identify automation opportunities in the above tasks, implement, validate and monitor them once deployed.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and evolutions of technologies used by NIRLAB.

**Requirements:**

* Open minded, willing to learn new skills and share your expertise.
* Proven experience building complex, production grade software products.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Advanced degrees or certifications in machine learning or cloud solutions are a plus.
* Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, C#, Typescript. Strong experience with at least one of the following frameworks is a big plus: Django/Django rest framework/Xamarin/.NET MAUI/Svelte/SvelteKit.
* Proficiency with version control systems (git).
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies (kanban, scrum).
* Experience with containerization (docker/docker compose, Kubernetes a plus).
* Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Infomaniak) is a plus.
* Experience with database management (MySQL/PostgreSQL) is a plus.
* Experience designing intuitive user interfaces and coherent user experiences is a plus.
* Knowledge of NIR spectroscopy and its applications is a plus.

**Benefits:**

* Opportunity to work with a cutting-edge technology company making a significant impact across various industries.
* Personal responsibility and fast pace in a dynamic and challenging working environment.
* Flat hierarchies, transparent communication, and an open and direct feedback culture.
* Flexible working environment with the ability to work remotely.
* Making the world a safer and better-informed through immediate, precise substance analysis.

We are proud to be a company changing the status quo in our industry. Join us and work with curious and innovative people, creative problem solvers, risk-takers, and dedicated colleagues as we reimagine the future of Mass Spec.

908 Devices does not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factors.
